from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.HC_DEBATE_AGENT_1,
                prompt_custom.HC_DEBATE_AGENT_2,
                prompt_custom.HC_DEBATE_AGENT_3,
            ],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.HC_DEBATE_AGG_V2,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        solution = await debate(problem)
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta()
        if self.aggregator_llm is self.llm:
            aggregator_usage = {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0}
        else:
            aggregator_usage = self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()
        return solution.get('response', "```text\nNO\n```"), {
            "worker": worker_usage,
            "aggregator": aggregator_usage,
        }

HC_DEBATE_AGENT_1 = """You are the cycle builder.
Solve the Hamiltonian Cycle puzzle for:
{problem}

Round {round}. Other proposals:
{all_proposals}

Try to construct a Hamiltonian cycle candidate. Prefer explicit edge-by-edge reasoning. If impossible, explain the obstruction briefly.
Do not output final prose. End with either:
CANDIDATE: [v0, ..., v0]
or
CANDIDATE: NO
"""

HC_DEBATE_AGENT_2 = """You are the skeptic.
Problem:
{problem}

Round {round}. Other proposals:
{all_proposals}

Your job is to find flaws: repeated/missing vertices, non-edges, wrong length, or failure to return to start. If a candidate is invalid, say so clearly. If all seen candidates fail, propose NO unless you can repair one.
End with exactly one line:
CANDIDATE: [v0, ..., v0]
or
CANDIDATE: NO
"""

HC_DEBATE_AGENT_3 = """You are the verifier-repairer.
Problem:
{problem}

Round {round}. Other proposals:
{all_proposals}

Check whether any proposed cycle visits every vertex exactly once and uses only listed edges, with last vertex equal to first. Repair only if you can fully validate the repaired cycle.
End with exactly one line:
CANDIDATE: [v0, ..., v0]
or
CANDIDATE: NO
"""

HC_DEBATE_AGG_V2 = """Given the Hamiltonian Cycle puzzle:
{problem}

Debate proposals:
{all_proposals}

Be conservative. Output a cycle only if some proposal provides enough information to certify all of the following:
1) the cycle length is N+1,
2) first vertex equals last vertex,
3) every vertex 0..N-1 appears exactly once except the repeated start/end,
4) every consecutive pair is an edge in the graph.

If proposals conflict, are incomplete, or any checklist item is uncertain, output NO.
Do not invent a cycle from partial hints. Prefer NO over an uncertain cycle.

[...]
